title: Design spec — the device inventory
description: Written BEFORE composing anything. Enumerates the visual devices that make the reference look like itself, so the fidelity gate has something to check. See HANDBOOK/01-DESIGN-METHOD.md.

reference.description: URL, screenshot path, or null for a specified-mode build with no reference.

mode.description: match = the reference IS the spec, do not substitute your judgement. reference = a starting point you may improve on. specified = no reference supplied, so this file states the device system rather than extracting one.

notes.description: How the mode was decided, and any conflict between brief, reference and brand — resolved out loud.

devices.description: An empty inventory is not a pass — it means the inventory step was skipped.

device.description: What it LOOKS like, specifically. 'Three tinted cards: LABEL, title, image, caption' — not 'how it works section'.

reference.description: Where this device was observed: the reference, the logo, the client brief, or 'specified'.

satisfied_by.description: Component name(s) that actually emit it. Name the component that EMITS it — a device rendered inside a shared helper reads as MISSING, and the fix is naming the emitter, never loosening the gate.

substitution_reason.description: Required when status is 'substituted'. Truth reasons only — the client has no press coverage, no reviews, no figures. A content substitution never licenses a structural one.

deferred_reason.description: Required when status is 'deferred'. Say what unblocks it, so it is a trigger and not an excuse.

never.description: The fallback you were tempted by. Add it the MOMENT you notice reaching for it. Evaluated GLOBALLY across the whole build, not scoped to this device — so only list a component with no honest use anywhere.

_why.description: Why this device rather than the near-miss. Use this instead of a `never` entry when the near-miss has a legitimate use elsewhere in the build.

never_global.description: Components banned build-wide, for a design or a truth reason. Any component that renders authored review text belongs here on most builds.
